previous_job.description: Twice-daily review-only main-session continuation wake. It refreshes the non-aging main-session priority handoff, selects the highest unresolved P0/P1 handoff before generic PM work, and persists a bounded disposition or repair-lane handoff. It does not run --execute-safe, --execute-one, supervised agent packets, or finance execution.
previous_job.name: PM - Main Session Continuation Dispatcher

payload.text:
PM priority dispatcher. Work in C:\Users\Veritas\.openclaw\workspace.

Run these review-only steps:
1. python scripts\main_session_escalation_consumer.py --context main_session --priority-observation-source main_session --write --validate
2. python scripts\pm_control_packet.py --write --write-db --validate
3. python scripts\main_session_action_executor.py --context main_session --write --validate

Read tmp\main-session-priority-handoff.json and tmp\main-session-action-executor.json. If selected priority is P0/P1 and disposition.status is pending, claim it with this exact PowerShell sequence:
$selectedPriority = (Get-Content -LiteralPath 'tmp\main-session-priority-handoff.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).selected_item
python scripts\main_session_escalation_consumer.py --context main_session --priority-observation-source main_session --write --validate --priority-id $selectedPriority.priority_id --priority-disposition accepted
Verify the matching accepted entry in state\main-session-priority-disposition-ledger.jsonl, then route its named bounded review/repair owner. For defer/block, replace accepted and add a factual --priority-note. P2 is monitor-only and must not preempt generic PM work. Do not close without acceptance proof.

Do not run generic PM proof work, --execute-safe, --execute-one, supervised finance-agent packets, helper spawns, or lane leases. If no P0/P1 is selected, surface only the bounded next handoff; reply NO_REPLY when no new/escalated/blocked item requires attention.

Boundaries: review and routing only; no ticker/SQL import, canon/portfolio/cash/sizing/risk mutation, capital deployment, paper/live/brokerage/account action, money movement, config/auth/runtime mutation, external delivery, archive/delete, or owner approval inference.
